text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Considering the circumstances, your
diligence
thus far has been greater than
my estimations.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! I'm diligent? And what specifically
makes
you think so?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
You've congratulated me on my
birthday, helped
me with problems in
class... Overall, you've
demonstrated a
meticulous attention to detail.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Your actions always looked careless
before, but
now I will have to update my
database.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! I'm the class rep, so it's only
normal that
I keep an eye on everyone in
our class!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
But right now it's not me, the
representative,
congratulating you. It's
me, your friend!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, friendship detected. Thank you,
Bakushin
O.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh right, I got you cleats for your
birthday
present, but I didn't know your
size. Sorry if they
don't fit great!
